description: This file defines an Android activity 'PresentationWithMediaRouterActivity' that demonstrates how to create an activity which manages secondary display presentations using MediaRouter and Presentation classes. It handles display detection, presentation lifecycle, media routing, and rendering with OpenGL.

classes.name: PresentationWithMediaRouterActivity
classes.description: Main activity that manages media routing and secondary display presentation using MediaRouter API, includes inner class DemoPresentation for display content.

classes.name: DemoPresentation
classes.description: Inner class extending Presentation, used to display content on a secondary display with a GLSurfaceView rendering a cube.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up media router, view components, and renderer.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers callback for media route changes and updates the presentation.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes media route callback and pauses rendering.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cleans up the presentation when the activity stops.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu and configures media routing action provider.

methods.name: updatePresentation
methods.description: Handles display switching logic based on current media route and display availability.

methods.name: updateContents
methods.description: Updates UI and rendering state depending on whether a display is present or not.
